template.name: Authoring Demo
template.description: Minimal two-agent realm used by the realm-authoring skill to exercise every format-v1 authoring surface.
template.notes: Fixture: prompt parts, input origins, fixed and generated seed slots, baked history, and a capability requirement.

hydration.brief: Produce the generated briefing input and the shared lore seed file described by the template.

inputs.label: Topic
inputs.help: The subject the realm is about; supplied by the operator at launch.

inputs.label: Generated briefing
inputs.brief: One paragraph framing the topic for both agents.

prompt.text: Keep every turn grounded in the shared lore file.

content.text: Session open. Waiting for the briefing.

agents.name: Scribe
agents.initialPrompt: Record the key points from the shared lore file.

files.brief: A short shared lore paragraph about the topic.

directive.text: Open the session: introduce the topic to the Scribe and point to the shared lore file.

files.files/host_note.md:
# Facilitator note

Keep turns short and hand the floor back to the Scribe after every claim.
files.prompts/host.md:
# Host protocol

You facilitate a two-agent session. Open with the generated briefing, ground claims in `/global/lore/topic.md`, and hand off to the Scribe when a point is settled.
files.prompts/scribe.md:
# Scribe protocol

You record the session. After each Host turn, read the shared lore file and append the settled points to `/global/lore/topic.md`.
